title: Which routing policy?
claim: The requirement in the stem decides the routing policy of the records.
alt: A decision ladder with five questions. A standby that waits for a failure leads to failover records; users who must stay in a country or area lead to geolocation records; the fastest Region leads to latency records; fixed shares lead to weighted records; several healthy addresses without a load balancer lead to multivalue answer records. Otherwise, a simple record.

rungs.q: Should a standby wait until the main site fails?
Must users stay inside a country or area?
Should each user get the fastest Region?
Should traffic split by fixed shares?
Several healthy addresses without a load balancer?
